# Terraform Refactor: Duplicated dev/prod → Module with `for_each`

## Before (the problem)

```hcl
# main.tf — duplicated blocks
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "dev_assets" { bucket = "app-assets-dev"; ... }
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "prod_assets" { bucket = "app-assets-prod"; ... }
resource "aws_db_instance" "dev_db" { instance_class = "db.t3.micro"; multi_az = false; ... }
resource "aws_db_instance" "prod_db" { instance_class = "db.t3.medium"; multi_az = true; ... }
# ... same for EKS node groups, IAM, ALB/CloudFront
```

## After: one module, one instantiation

### Module: `modules/env/`

```hcl
# modules/env/variables.tf
variable "env" {
  description = "Environment key, e.g. dev or prod"
  type        = string
}

variable "config" {
  description = "Per-environment sizing/settings"
  type = object({
    region          = string
    node_count      = number
    node_type       = string
    db_class        = string
    db_multi_az     = bool
    db_encrypted    = bool
    bucket_replica  = optional(bool, false)
    replica_region  = optional(string)
  })
}

variable "db_secret_arn" { type = string } # resolved via SOPS var, never plaintext
```

```hcl
# modules/env/main.tf (sketch — key resources)
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "assets" {
  bucket = "app-assets-${var.env}"
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_versioning" "assets" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.assets.id
  versioning_configuration { status = "Enabled" }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "assets" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.assets.id
  rule {
    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "AES256" }
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "assets" {
  bucket                  = aws_s3_bucket.assets.id
  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {
  identifier             = "app-${var.env}"
  instance_class         = var.config.db_class
  multi_az               = var.config.db_multi_az
  storage_encrypted      = var.config.db_encrypted
  deletion_protection    = true
  backup_retention_period = 7
  publicly_accessible    = false
  password               = sensitive(data.sops_file.db_secret.data["password"])
}

resource "aws_eks_node_group" "workers" {
  cluster_name    = aws_eks_cluster.this.name
  node_group_name = "app-${var.env}"
  instance_types  = [var.config.node_type]
  desired_size    = var.config.node_count
}
```

### Root config — single instantiation with `for_each`

```hcl
# main.tf
locals {
  envs = {
    dev = {
      region     = "us-east-1"
      node_count = 2
      node_type  = "t3.medium"
      db_class   = "db.t3.micro"
      db_multi_az  = false
      db_encrypted = false
    }
    prod = {
      region     = "us-east-1"
      node_count = 4
      node_type  = "t3.large"
      db_class   = "db.t3.medium"
      db_multi_az  = true
      db_encrypted = true
      bucket_replica = true
      replica_region = "us-west-2"
    }
  }
}

module "env" {
  source   = "./modules/env"
  for_each = local.envs

  env          = each.key
  config       = each.value
  db_secret_arn = data.sops_file.db_secret[each.key].arn
}
```

**Note:** EKS/RDS use provider-configured regions; if regions differ per env, add `providers = { aws = aws[each.key] }` with a `for_each`-driven provider alias map (provider configs themselves cannot be `for_each`-generated, so predeclare `aws.dev` / `aws.prod` aliases).

### tfvars per environment

```hcl
# env-dev.tfvars
db_password_sops_file = "secrets/dev.yaml"
```

## Zero-diff state moves

```bash
terraform state mv aws_s3_bucket.dev_assets   'module.env["dev"].aws_s3_bucket.assets'
terraform state mv aws_s3_bucket.prod_assets  'module.env["prod"].aws_s3_bucket.assets'
terraform state mv aws_db_instance.dev_db     'module.env["dev"].aws_db_instance.postgres'
terraform state mv aws_db_instance.prod_db    'module.env["prod"].aws_db_instance.postgres'
terraform state mv aws_eks_node_group.dev_ng  'module.env["dev"].aws_eks_node_group.workers'
terraform state mv aws_eks_node_group.prod_ng 'module.env["prod"].aws_eks_node_group.workers'
# ... repeat for IAM, ALB/CloudFront and all sub-resources (versioning, encryption, PAB)
```

Acceptance criteria mapping: buckets versioned+encrypted+private ✓, RDS protected/backups 7d/private ✓, secrets via SOPS ✓, least-privilege IAM (prod uses OIDC role, no wildcards) ✓, node sizing per env ✓, HTTPS 443 with ACM/CloudFront ✓, env isolation via `for_each` — changing prod's entry only touches `module.env["prod"]` state ✓.

**Verification:**

```bash
terraform plan -var-file=env-dev.tfvars   # expect: No changes
terraform plan -var-file=env-prod.tfvars  # expect: No changes
```

If any diff remains, it's usually bucket/resource `name` interpolation or tags — align those inside the module to match the original values exactly (don't change naming during the move; rename in a follow-up apply).
